article_body_content:
The competition for attention in 2026 is fierce. Products no longer compete just on design or utility - they compete on how fast they can stop a scrolling thumb. In this new digital landscape, visuals speak louder than campaigns, and Sora 2 Trends gives creators and brands the ability to make that moment of attention happen on command.

2. The Power of Presets: Your Shortcut to Visual Identity

Presets are the creative backbone of Sora 2 Trends. Instead of starting from a blank screen

Here are some of the most popular presets available on Alici.AI:

  • Luxury Ad – A slow, cinematic presentation with polished lighting, reflections, and premium textures. Perfect for jewelry, fashion, and cosmetics.

  • Japanese Ad – Clean composition, natural light, minimalist text overlays, and a peaceful rhythm designed for calm emotional engagement.

Each preset defines tone and pacing - but every detail, from music to text overlay, can be customized. This flexibility lets creators move fast while keeping control over visual personality.

3. From Concept to Video: How the Process Works

Creating with Sora 2 Trends follows a natural three-step path:

  1. Upload or Describe Your Product – Add your image or write a short concept prompt.

  2. Choose Preset & Pacing – Pick from cinematic, energetic, or minimalist modes. Adjust pacing (Auto, No Cuts, Slow, Fast) to match your platform goal.

  3. Preview and Refine – Sora 2 Trends generates multiple short clips in optimized aspect ratios (9:16 vertical for social, 1:1 for feeds, 16:9 for YouTube).

4. Ad Formats and Distribution Made Simple

Alici.AI’s platform doesn’t just create the videos - it formats and optimizes them for every major platform automatically. Each ad is rendered in multiple aspect ratios and compression standards to fit:

  • Instagram Reels & TikTok (vertical 9:16)

  • YouTube Shorts (vertical 9:16 and square 1:1 options)

  • Facebook & LinkedIn Feeds (1:1 or 4:5 formats)

  • Pinterest Video Pins and Snap Ads (vertical short format)
